'''Callia's''' was an antiques shop that was located aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Cal Ambre]]'' during the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It was owned and operated by [[Retter Lewis]] and specialized in rare and unusual religious artifacts, but also served as a front for a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] network.

==Location==
The shop was located on the main mall level of the ''Cal Ambre'', between [[Larjh StarCorporation]] and an exclusive clothier.<ref name="CRO" />

==Design==
The shop had two levels: The lower level had a public gallery in the front, which was similar to a museum in appearance: Artifacts were placed on displays complete with [[Hologram/Legends|holorepresentations]]. Prices weren't posted on any artifact, under the assumption that if a being had to ask the price, then they couldn't afford it anyway.<ref name="CRO" /> In the back there was a smaller gallery for serious buyers. This gallery contained the most precious artifacts, many of them connected to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. While casual shoppers weren't allowed access, agents of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] often acquired these Force-connected items.<ref name="CRO" /> The upper level was dedicated to storage areas, vaults, and offices.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personnel==
The shop was owned and operated by Retter Lewis, a scholar and specialist for artifacts. He had two permanent employees: [[Graff Teiras]] served as store manager and liaison to shippers, sellers, and dealers, and [[Halacc Demior]] served as both accountant and bodyguard. [[A-3PO]], a silver [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], served as translator. During peak times, additional employees, mostly [[University/Legends|university]] students, were hired.<ref name="CRO" />

==Security==
The shop was protected by a very sophisticated security system. While Retter Lewis had Halacc Demior as a bodyguard, he relied on the ''Cal Ambre''{{'s}} security forces for external protection.<ref name="CRO" />

==Operations==
===Legit business===
Retter had contacts all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and bought unique items and artifacts from estates and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] for his shop. There, he sold them again to wealthy collectors and universities. The shop received a constant flow of [[Courier/Legends|couriers]], customers, and dealers. Many powerful Imperial figures like [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], bureaucrats, and officers were frequently seen in Callia's, as well as servants of the Emperor, who looked for Force-connected artifacts.<ref name="CRO" />

===Rebel cell===
Retter's shop served as a perfect cover for a Rebel transportation network. Retter, Halacc, and Graff organized routes and destinations for defecting Imperial officers and officials or fleeing Rebel agents from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CRO" /> Rebel agents informed Retter of incoming "hot properties," and Retter organized their transfer to Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]]. They either left the ship with faked IDs or were smuggled off board. Since Retter had the respect of several high-ranking Imperials, the [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] agent seldom checked Retter's cargo.<ref name="CRO" /> While Retter Lewis was the mastermind of the whole operation, artifact dealing kept him busy most of the time. Graff, the chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], managed the day-to-day schedules and operation of the network and maintained contact with the Rebel Alliance. Halacc, a trained combat expert, aided in operations.<ref name="CRO" />
